name: React 17 to React 18 Migration Recipe

breaking_changes.title: ReactDOM.render is deprecated; use createRoot
breaking_changes.description: ReactDOM.render and ReactDOM.hydrate are removed in React 18. Use createRoot and hydrateRoot from react-dom/client instead.

breaking_changes.title: Automatic batching now applies to all updates
breaking_changes.description: In React 18, state updates inside setTimeout, promises, and native event handlers are also batched. Code relying on non-batched updates (checking state immediately after setState in async contexts) may behave differently.
breaking_changes.replacement: Wrap updates you want to opt out of batching with ReactDOM.flushSync().

breaking_changes.title: StrictMode double-invokes effects in development
breaking_changes.description: React 18 StrictMode now mounts, unmounts, and remounts components in development to surface effect cleanup issues. Effects must be idempotent.
breaking_changes.replacement: Ensure useEffect cleanup functions properly reverse side-effects.

breaking_changes.title: Suspense layout effect timing changed
breaking_changes.description: In React 18, useLayoutEffect is no longer called on the server. Code conditionally running layout effects on server may need to be guarded.
breaking_changes.replacement: Use useEffect for non-layout concerns, or guard with typeof window check.

deprecated_apis.replacement: root.unmount() on the root returned by createRoot

migration_actions.description: Update react-dom and @types/react to ^18.0.0 in package.json
Audit async code that reads state immediately after setState calls for unexpected batching

manual_considerations: Third-party libraries must also be React 18 compatible (react-query, react-router, testing-library versions).
React 18 requires react-dom@18 as a peer dependency — ensure both are updated together.
Server-side rendering (renderToString) still works but concurrent features require renderToPipeableStream.
Test environment: @testing-library/react v13+ is required for React 18 support.
